property_summary: On any successful fillOrder, the returned positionId must equal the hash of the opposite (flipped isLong) order — i.e. the id of the position actually minted to the taker — which the mutant breaks because it returns the default 0 instead.
change_summary: Delete the assignment `positionId = uint256(oppositeOrderHash);` so fillOrder returns the default value 0 on success.
